details: @clikwraps/navigate@99.9.1 is a dependency-confusion staging stub published under a name that misspells the @clickwraps scope. The tarball holds no functional code — package/index.js is an empty `module.exports = {}` and package.json declares no lifecycle scripts and no bin — but its sole dependency is a raw off-registry tarball: "ltidisafe": "hxxps://ltidi[.]storage[.]googleapis[.]com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4[.]0[.]8[.]tgz". Installing the package makes npm download and unpack a tarball from a Google Cloud Storage bucket (ltidi, path /depenconf/) that never went through registry review; the filename ltidisafe-4.0.8.tgz and the "depenconf" path indicate an attempt to substitute an internal package named ltidisafe. The off-registry dependency and the sentinel version 99.9.1 are the only behaviour in the package; the remote tarball's own code is not included here. IOC: hxxps://ltidi[.]storage.googleapis[.]com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4.0.8.tgz

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
